The last page of Acts and the last page of John: an apostle unchained in spirit, and a disciple called to follow on his own road.

sub: The Messiah, fulfilment of Israel's hope.
q: For surely I know the plans I have for you, says the Lord, plans for your welfare and not for harm, to give you a future with hope.
For this reason therefore I have asked to see you and speak with you, since it is for the sake of the hope of Israel that I am bound with this chain.
points.apply: Pray this week for the Jewish people and for good relations between Christians and Jews, remembering that our hope was first theirs.

sub: Two whole years in a rented house.
The word that cannot be chained.
q: So shall my word be that goes out from my mouth; it shall not return to me empty, but it shall accomplish that which I purpose, and succeed in the thing for which I sent it.
proclaiming the kingdom of God and teaching about the Lord Jesus Christ with all boldness and without hindrance.
points.apply: Welcome one person into your home or your time this week, and let them see your faith.

points.h: What is that to you? Follow me!
sub: A true witness who has written.
q: Where you go, I will go; where you lodge, I will lodge; your people shall be my people, and your God my God.
Jesus said to him, “If it is my will that he remain until I come, what is that to you? Follow me!”
points.apply: Name one person you often compare yourself with, and pray for them by name each day until next Sunday.

concl: Acts and John both end with an open door: the story of Christ's witnesses is not finished.
The Spirit who comes at Pentecost will write the next lines in us, if we follow Jesus on our own road and bear true witness.
2027-05-15.resolve: Join the Vigil of Pentecost or pray tonight for the gifts of the Holy Spirit, and stop comparing; follow.

intro: Theme: “Here is your mother.”
The day after Pentecost: the woman of the first promise, the Mother given from the cross, and the Mother praying with the newborn Church.

q: I will put enmity between you and the woman, and between your offspring and hers; he will strike your head, and you will strike his heel.
But when the fullness of time had come, God sent his Son, born of a woman, born under the law,
points.apply: When you face temptation this week, pray: Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now.

q: The man named his wife Eve, because she was the mother of all living.
Then he said to the disciple, “Here is your mother.” And from that hour the disciple took her into his own home.
points.apply: Give Mary a visible place in your home this week: a picture, a candle, and a family prayer before it.

sub: Blood and water from the pierced side.
The Church gathered in the upper room.
q: Glorious things are spoken of you, O city of God.
All these were constantly devoting themselves to prayer, together with certain women, including Mary the mother of Jesus, as well as his brothers.
points.apply: Pray the Angelus every day this week, at noon or in the evening, as the Church does in Ordinary Time.

concl: From Eden to Calvary to the upper room, God has placed a Mother at the heart of his plan of salvation.
Jesus gave her to us from the cross; she prayed with the apostles for the Spirit; she remains the Mother of the Church in its ordinary days.
2027-05-17.resolve: Take Mary into your home: pray the Angelus each day this week and do whatever Jesus tells you.

intro: Theme: “Whoever wants to be first must be last of all and servant of all.”
Gold tested in the fire, disciples arguing about rank, and a child in the arms of Jesus.

sub: Faith is no insurance against trouble.
Has anyone trusted and been disappointed?
q: For gold is tested in the fire, and those found acceptable, in the furnace of humiliation.
Blessed is anyone who endures temptation. Such a one has stood the test and will receive the crown of life that the Lord has promised to those who love him.
points.apply: Name your present trial before God each morning this week and add: I cling to you, Lord.

q: The greater you are, the more you must humble yourself; so you will find favor in the sight of the Lord.
He sat down, called the twelve, and said to them, “Whoever wants to be first must be last of all and servant of all.”
points.apply: In one meeting or family discussion this week, let someone else have the last word and the credit.

sub: Welcome the child, welcome Christ, welcome the Father.
q: But I have calmed and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with its mother; my soul is like the weaned child that is with me.
Whoever welcomes one such child in my name welcomes me, and whoever welcomes me welcomes not me but the one who sent me.
points.apply: Give real time this week to a child or to someone overlooked: listen, play, teach, or simply sit with them.

concl: The way of the disciple passes through the furnace, but the Lord is compassionate and never forsakes those who cling to him.
Greatness in the Kingdom is measured by service, and the little ones are where Christ waits to be welcomed.
2027-05-18.resolve: Do one hidden service each day this week for someone who cannot repay you.

intro: Theme: “Whoever is not against us is for us.”
Wisdom who teaches her children, the hard paths of her schooling, and a Lord who will not let jealousy shrink his Kingdom.

sub: To love Wisdom is to love life.
q: I love those who love me, and those who seek me diligently find me.
but to those who are the called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ the power of God and the wisdom of God.
points.apply: Begin each day this week with ten minutes of the Gospel before anything else.

sub: Discipline that hurts for a time.
q: Then she will come straight back to them again and gladden them, and will reveal her secrets to them.
Now, discipline always seems painful rather than pleasant at the time, but later it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those who have been trained by it.
points.apply: Thank God this week for one hard season of your life and the lesson it gave you.

sub: Moses and the two prophets in the camp.
Glad at every good done in his name.
q: But Moses said to him, “Are you jealous for my sake? Would that all the Lord's people were prophets, and that the Lord would put his spirit on them!”
Whoever is not against us is for us.
points.apply: Pray by name this week for another parish, Church or group, and speak well of them to someone.

concl: Wisdom schools us patiently, through hard paths, until our hearts can be trusted with her secrets.
A heart formed by Christ's wisdom is never jealous of God's goodness, and prays for the unity of all who bear his name.
2027-05-19.resolve: Each day this week, thank God for one good work done by people outside your own circle.

intro: Theme: “Do not delay to turn back to the Lord.”
False securities, the danger of tomorrow, and the salt of a heart converted today.

q: Do not be so confident of forgiveness that you add sin to sin.
Or do you despise the riches of his kindness and forbearance and patience? Do you not realize that God's kindness is meant to lead you to repentance?
points.apply: Write down one false security you lean on, and give it to God in prayer.

sub: Cut off what makes you stumble.
Nothing is worth losing life for.
q: Do not delay to turn back to the Lord, and do not postpone it from day to day.
See, now is the acceptable time; see, now is the day of salvation!
points.apply: Make your confession this week, or take one decisive step away from an occasion of sin.

points.h: A cup of water and the salt of peace
sub: No kindness for Christ is lost.
Do not scandalise the little ones.
Salt and peace with one another.
q: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.
Salt is good; but if salt has lost its saltiness, how can you season it? Have salt in yourselves, and be at peace with one another.
points.apply: Make peace this week with one person from whom you are estranged.

concl: God's patience is not permission; it is an invitation to turn back today.
A heart that turns to Christ cuts away what leads to sin, gives cups of water in his name, and lives at peace.
2027-05-20.resolve: Say the name of Jesus with love each hour today, as St Bernardine taught, and turn to him without delay.

intro: Theme: “What God has joined together, let no one separate.”
The treasure of faithful friends, marriage as God made it from the beginning, and the faithfulness of the martyrs.

sub: Friends at the table and friends in trouble.
The fear of the Lord makes friendship firm.
q: Faithful friends are a sturdy shelter: whoever finds one has found a treasure.

I do not call you servants any longer, because the servant does not know what the master is doing; but I have called you friends, because I have made known to you everything that I have heard from my Father.
points.apply: Visit or call one friend in difficulty this week and stay with them for a while.

sub: Behind the debate to God's plan.
q: Therefore a man leaves his father and his mother and clings to his wife, and they become one flesh.
So they are no longer two, but one flesh. Therefore what God has joined together, let no one separate.
points.apply: If you are married, renew your vows privately in prayer with your spouse this week; if not, pray for one couple by name each day.

points.h: A new heart and a faithful love
q: A new heart I will give you, and a new spirit I will put within you; and I will remove from your body the heart of stone and give you a heart of flesh.
No one has greater love than this, to lay down one's life for one's friends.
points.apply: Ask St Christopher Magallanes for the grace to forgive one person who has hurt you.

concl: Friendship and marriage are God's works, made firm by the fear of the Lord and by the grace of Christ.
The martyrs, like St Christopher Magallanes, show the deepest faithfulness: to give one's life for the Friend who gave his for us.
2027-05-21.resolve: Be a sturdy shelter for one person this week, and pray daily for the marriages you know.

intro: Theme: “Receive the kingdom of God as a little child.”
Dust and divine image, the compassion of the Father, and the Kingdom given to children.

sub: Made for praise and for the neighbour.
q: He endowed them with strength like his own, and made them in his own image.
and have clothed yourselves with the new self, which is being renewed in knowledge according to the image of its creator.
points.apply: Each evening this week, thank God for one gift of your senses or mind that you used well that day.

points.h: He remembers that we are dust
sub: Our weakness does not surprise God.
q: As a father has compassion for his children, so the Lord has compassion for those who fear him. For he knows how we were made; he remembers that we are dust.
See what love the Father has given us, that we should be called children of God; and that is what we are.
points.apply: When you fail this week, say: Father, you remember that I am dust; and begin again.

sub: Receive the Kingdom with open hands.
q: Can a woman forget her nursing child, or show no compassion for the child of her womb? Even these may forget, yet I will not forget you.
Truly I tell you, whoever does not receive the kingdom of God as a little child will never enter it.
points.apply: Bless a child with the sign of the cross each night this week, or pray for the children of your neighbourhood.

concl: We are dust and we are made in God's image; the Father's compassion holds both truths together.
The Kingdom is not earned but received, as a child receives, as St Rita received even the thorns of her life from God's hands.
2027-05-22.resolve: Come to God this week as a child: one short prayer each hour, “Abba, Father, I trust you.”

intro: Theme: “For God all things are possible.”
The road of return that God opens, the loving gaze of Jesus, and the grace that makes the impossible possible.

sub: Silence that sickens, confession that heals.
q: Turn back to the Lord and forsake your sins; pray in his presence and lessen your offense.
So he set off and went to his father. But while he was still far off, his father saw him and was filled with compassion; he ran and put his arms around him and kissed him.
points.apply: Receive the sacrament of Reconciliation this week, or set a date for it.

sub: A sincere man on his knees.
q: I have loved you with an everlasting love; therefore I have continued my faithfulness to you.
Jesus, looking at him, loved him and said, “You lack one thing; go, sell what you own, and give the money to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; then come, follow me.”
points.apply: Sit before a crucifix for five minutes and let Jesus look at you with love; then name the one thing you find hardest to give him.

points.h: For God all things are possible
q: Is anything too wonderful for the Lord?
Jesus looked at them and said, “For mortals it is impossible, but not for God; for God all things are possible.”
points.apply: Give away one possession you are attached to this week, and entrust one impossible situation to God.

concl: God always opens the road of return, and his mercy is greater than our sins.
Jesus looks at us with love and asks us to hold nothing more tightly than him; what is impossible for us is possible for God.
2027-05-24.resolve: Make one generous act of letting go this week, and ask Mary, Help of Christians, to help you follow her Son.

intro: Theme: “Give to the Most High as he has given to you.”
Every good deed an offering, every gift given gladly, and a God who repays a hundredfold.

points.h: Every good deed is an offering
q: The one who returns a kindness offers choice flour, and one who gives alms sacrifices a thank offering.
Do not neglect to do good and to share what you have, for such sacrifices are pleasing to God.
points.apply: Tonight, before sleeping, offer to God the good things you did today, however small, as your evening sacrifice.

sub: As generously as you can afford.
q: Those who bring thanksgiving as their sacrifice honor me; to those who go the right way I will show the salvation of God.
Each of you must give as you have made up your mind, not reluctantly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.
points.apply: Decide this week what you will give to the poor or to the parish, and give it gladly, without complaint or display.

sub: Eternal life in the age to come.
q: For the Lord is the one who repays, and he will repay you sevenfold.
But many who are first will be last, and the last will be first.
points.apply: Thank God this week for one person in the Church who has been a brother, sister, father or mother to you, and tell that person so.

concl: Ben Sira teaches that the best offering is a life of kindness and alms, given with a cheerful face.
Jesus promises that no one who gives to him will lose: a hundredfold now, with persecutions, and eternal life to come.
2027-05-25.resolve: Give one gift each day this week, gladly and quietly, as an offering to God.

intro: Theme: “The Son of Man came not to be served but to serve.”
A prayer that all nations may know God, a request for thrones, and a Master who serves.

sub: Hear the prayer of your servants.
q: Hear, O Lord, the prayer of your servants, according to your goodwill toward your people, and all who are on the earth will know that you are the Lord, the God of the ages.
And this is eternal life, that they may know you, the only true God, and Jesus Christ whom you have sent.
points.apply: Pray each day this week for one nation or people who do not yet know Christ.

q: Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of your name; deliver us, and forgive our sins, for your name's sake.
But Jesus said to them, “You do not know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I drink, or be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?”
points.apply: When you receive Holy Communion this week, tell the Lord: I am willing to share your cup, give me strength.

points.h: Not to be served but to serve
sub: Rulers who lord it over others.
q: Do not exalt yourself, or you may fall and bring dishonor upon yourself.
But it is not so among you; but whoever wishes to become great among you must be your servant,
points.apply: Each day this week do one hidden act of service with joy, as St Philip Neri would.

concl: Ben Sira prays that God's people may make God known to the nations.
Jesus shows how: not by thrones, but by the cup of self-giving and the joy of service.
2027-05-26.resolve: Look each day this week for the lowest place, and take it gladly.

intro: Theme: “What do you want me to do for you?”
A Creator whose works are full of glory, and a Saviour who stands still for a blind man.

points.h: Who could ever tire of his glory?
sub: The sun full of his glory.
q: I will now call to mind the works of the Lord, and will declare what I have seen. By the word of the Lord his works are made; and all his creatures do his will.
All things came into being through him, and without him not one thing came into being.
points.apply: Each evening this week name one beautiful thing you saw that day and thank the Creator for it.

points.h: He cried out even more loudly
q: This poor soul cried, and was heard by the Lord, and was saved from every trouble.
Many sternly ordered him to be quiet, but he cried out even more loudly, “Son of David, have mercy on me!”
points.apply: Bring to Jesus this week the prayer you have stopped praying because it seemed useless, and pray it again with confidence.

points.h: Let me see again, and follow
q: Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, and the ears of the deaf unstopped;
Jesus said to him, “Go; your faith has made you well.” Immediately he regained his sight and followed him on the way.
points.apply: Name one “cloak” you cling to, a habit, a fear or a possession, and let it go this week in order to follow Jesus more closely.

concl: Ben Sira cannot tire of the glory of the Creator who made all things by his word.
That same Word stood still for blind Bartimaeus, opened his eyes, and let him follow on the way.
2027-05-27.resolve: Pray the prayer of Bartimaeus every day this week: Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me.

intro: Theme: “Whenever you stand praying, forgive.”
The forgotten godly, a fig tree with leaves only, and a house of prayer and forgiveness.

q: But these also were godly men, whose righteous deeds have not been forgotten;

Therefore, since we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, let us also lay aside every weight and the sin that clings so closely, and let us run with perseverance the race that is set before us,
points.apply: Visit or call an elderly relative this week and thank them for the faith they handed on.

sub: A tree that looks good from afar.
q: They are like trees planted by streams of water, which yield their fruit in its season, and their leaves do not wither. In all that they do, they prosper.
My Father is glorified by this, that you bear much fruit and become my disciples.
points.apply: Choose one religious practice you do out of habit and do it this week with your whole heart.

points.h: A house of prayer and forgiveness
q: for my house shall be called a house of prayer for all peoples.
Whenever you stand praying, forgive, if you have anything against anyone; so that your Father in heaven may also forgive you your trespasses.
points.apply: Before Sunday Mass, be reconciled with one person, by a word, a call or at least a prayer for them.

concl: God does not forget the quiet goodness of those whom history forgets.
Jesus looks for fruit in his house: faith in God, true prayer and a forgiving heart.
2027-05-28.resolve: Each evening this week, forgive before you pray.

intro: Theme: “I sought wisdom openly in my prayer.”
Wisdom sought from youth, a law sweeter than honey, and a question that only an honest heart can answer.

q: While I was still young, before I went on my travels, I sought wisdom openly in my prayer.
If any of you is lacking in wisdom, ask God, who gives to all generously and ungrudgingly, and it will be given you.
points.apply: Each morning this week, before work or study, ask God for wisdom in one sentence of prayer.

sub: The law that revives the soul.
q: More to be desired are they than gold, even much fine gold; sweeter also than honey, and drippings of the honeycomb.
for he taught them as one having authority, and not as their scribes.
points.apply: Read one chapter of a Gospel slowly this week, and stop at the verse that tastes sweetest to you.

q: The fear of others lays a snare, but one who trusts in the Lord is secure.
For this I was born, and for this I came into the world, to testify to the truth. Everyone who belongs to the truth listens to my voice.
points.apply: This week, in one situation where you are tempted to hide the truth for fear of others, speak it gently and clearly.

concl: Ben Sira found wisdom by seeking her in prayer from his youth until his old age.
Jesus' authority is recognised not by calculation but by hearts that seek the truth; St Paul VI showed that authority is credible when it serves and witnesses.
2027-05-29.resolve: Begin every task this week with a short prayer for wisdom.

intro: Theme: “Blessed is she who believed.”
The joy of daughter Zion, the haste of love, the faith that Elizabeth praised, and the song of the lowly lifted up.

sub: A song in a dark time.
q: The Lord, your God, is in your midst, a warrior who gives victory; he will rejoice over you with gladness, he will renew you in his love;
And he came to her and said, “Greetings, favored one! The Lord is with you.”
points.apply: Begin each day this week with the Angelus or a Hail Mary, remembering that the Lord is with you too.

points.h: With haste to the hill country
sub: The Ark goes up to Judah.
q: David was afraid of the Lord that day; he said, “How can the ark of the Lord come into my care?”
In those days Mary set out and went with haste to a Judean town in the hill country,
points.apply: Make one visit this week that you have been postponing, to someone sick, old or alone.

q: And he believed the Lord; and the Lord reckoned it to him as righteousness.
And blessed is she who believed that there would be a fulfillment of what was spoken to her by the Lord.
points.apply: Pray a decade of the Rosary each day this week for someone whose faith is weak.

q: Hannah prayed and said, “My heart exults in the Lord; my strength is exalted in my God.
And Mary said, “My soul magnifies the Lord, and my spirit rejoices in God my Savior,
points.apply: Give food or help to one hungry person or family this week, so that Mary's song comes true through you.

concl: In Mary the Lord is truly in the midst of his people; she carries him with haste to serve.
Elizabeth praises her faith, and Mary sings of the God who lifts up the lowly; we close the month of May by learning her joy and her readiness.
2027-05-31.resolve: Pray the Magnificat each evening this week and make one visit of service, as Mary did.
